children: According to Wallstreetcn, Fed Governor Kevin Warsh said the Federal Reserve's September policy meeting has become a key moment in its mission to curb prices, warning that price pressures have not shown meaningful easing and that if inflation remains far above the Fed's 2% target, he will have little choice but to raise rates this year.

title: Fed Governor Kevin Warsh Says September Policy Meeting Is a Key Moment in Curbing Inflation
